verdict.rationale: Anytype documents explicit Markdown export/import (choose Markdown or Any-Block format) and supports importing/exporting content at any time, plus local encrypted-at-rest storage that isn't vendor-locked (anytype-docs-11, anytype-docs-20, anytype-comm-9). However, JSON export isn't documented, the proprietary 'Any-Block' format is offered alongside Markdown (not purely open), and there's no independent verification of export completeness/fidelity for archival purposes. Missing for 10: documented JSON export option, independent/hands-on confirmation that full notes (databases, links, properties) survive export losslessly.
